clue.text: Agent for landlords, perhaps, one writes

definitions.meaning: read playfully, a man who handles lettings for landlords is a '...'

explanation.surface: A description of a letting agent, with a note that this person also does some writing.
explanation.walkthrough: The first definition is cryptic: a letting agent deals in 'lets', so is a man of lets, or letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A man of letters is a scholar or author, someone whose trade is the written word.

clue.text: Former PM embraces something ludicrous in elevated style

indicators.note: to embrace is to hold within, so one word goes inside the other

parts.note: Theresa May was a British Prime Minister
a jest is a joke, something laughable

explanation.surface: A former Prime Minister adopting something absurd while trying to sound grand.
explanation.walkthrough: Theresa May was UK Prime Minister 2016-19.
explanation.definitionFit: Majesty is stately grandeur or dignity, a lofty manner or appearance.

clue.text: Opening for executive with routine career, coming over for training

indicators.note: in a down clue, coming over means the assembled letters are flipped upwards, read backwards
the opening of a word is its first letter

parts.note: a rut is a dull routine
a career can be a run, a course or period of activity

explanation.surface: An executive's start in a career that becomes routine, then moving across for training.
explanation.definitionFit: Nurture is upbringing, the care and education that trains someone as they grow.

clue.text: If returned, Democrat to be elected leader of government that's wriggling

indicators.note: returned means the word is sent back, read in the opposite direction

parts.note: to get in is to win an election

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A conditional political scenario about a Democrat being chosen to lead a squirming government.
explanation.definitionFit: Fidgeting is restless twitching movement, a synonym for squirming about.

clue.text: Banish former partner on French island

parts.note: an ex is a former spouse or partner
île is French for island

explanation.surface: An instruction to send an ex away to an island off France.
explanation.definitionFit: To exile someone is to expel them from their homeland, a synonym of banish.

clue.text: Excellent sauce

definitions.meaning: something poured or spread over food

explanation.surface: Praise for a very good sauce.
explanation.definitionFit: Topping as an adjective is old-fashioned praise; as a noun it is a garnish or sauce on top of a dish.

clue.text: More elegant author loses head over unknown one

indicators.note: over here means the word lies across and covers the other pieces, enclosing them
losing its head means the word drops its first letter

parts.note: an author is a writer
in algebra Z is an unknown quantity
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A decapitated author standing over some unidentified person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'loses head' takes W from WRITER, giving RITER; 'over' then has it surround ZI.
explanation.definitionFit: Ritzy means showily smart or luxurious, after the Ritz hotel, so ritzier is classier.

clue.text: Culinary classic of Dr Law?

parts.note: read the answer as wordplay: WALDORF in a 'salad', that is jumbled, gives the letters of these three words

explanation.surface: A famous dish credited to a doctor named Law.
explanation.walkthrough: A reverse clue: 'salad' means a mixture, so a salad of WALDORF is a scramble of its letters, which are those of OF DR LAW.
explanation.definitionFit: The Waldorf salad of apple, celery and walnuts is a long-established dish from New York's Waldorf hotel.

clue.text: Sailor, hurt leaving home, swore to give up

parts.note: AB, able seaman, is a sailor

indicators.note: leaving means one piece departs from the other word

parts.note: hurt means injured
in can mean at home

explanation.surface: An injured sailor quitting home and vowing to renounce something.
explanation.definitionFit: To abjure is to renounce formally, typically under oath.

clue.text: What cat might say to American encouragement

parts.note: a cat could say 'I'm pet', since it is a pet
US is short for the United States, hence American

explanation.surface: A cat's imagined remark to an American offering encouragement.
explanation.walkthrough: The cat says I'M PET, a playful spoken phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: Impetus is a driving force or stimulus, the push that encourages action.

clue.text: More than one relation in militia rises unexpectedly

indicators.note: unexpectedly suggests the letters turn up in a surprising new order

explanation.surface: A militia rising up in an unforeseen revolt.
explanation.definitionFit: Similarities are resemblances, relations of likeness between things; the plural matches 'more than one'.

clue.text: Spades placed in long row

indicators.note: in means these pieces are set inside the other word

parts.note: to be dying for something is to long for it, so die means long
S is the card-suit abbreviation for spades
put means placed

explanation.surface: Garden spades laid out in a long line.
explanation.walkthrough: 'long' looks like an adjective for 'row'; it is the verb, as in 'dying to'.
explanation.definitionFit: A row (rhymes with 'cow') is a quarrel, which is a dispute.

clue.text: Preference for the best space around settled island

indicators.note: around means the first piece wraps round the others

parts.note: an em is a printer's space
lit means settled or alighted, as a bird does

explanation.surface: Someone wanting the finest space around a colonised island.
explanation.definitionFit: Elitism is the belief that a select superior group should be favoured.

clue.text: King becomes husband in merry cycling verse

indicators.note: cycling means letters go round from one end of the word to the other
becomes signals one letter turning into another

parts.note: R, for rex, abbreviates king

explanation.surface: A king turns into a husband in a jolly poem.
explanation.walkthrough: 'becomes' makes MERRY into MERHY; 'cycling' moves ME from the front to the back.
explanation.definitionFit: A rhyme is a short poem or jingle, a piece of verse.

clue.text: Independent horse crosses middle of rough river first

indicators.note: crosses suggests the horse spanning a gap, its letters straddling another

parts.note: a nag is an old horse

indicators.note: the middle of a word is its central letter

parts.note: the Ural is a river in Russia and Kazakhstan

explanation.surface: A lone horse crossing rough ground before a river.
explanation.definitionFit: An inaugural event is the first of its kind, the opening one.

clue.text: Starter opposing late beginning of Oaks

parts.note: anti means against
past means late, gone by

indicators.note: the beginning of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A racing tip against a late start to the Oaks, a classic for fillies.
explanation.walkthrough: The Oaks is a famous flat horse race at Epsom.
explanation.definitionFit: Antipasto is an Italian appetiser, eaten before the main meal.

clue.text: Where bucks get wasted?

parts.note: bucks are male deer but also young men; wasted means very drunk, as men are at a pre-wedding party

explanation.walkthrough: The surface hints at deer being culled or money squandered; really it is about young men drinking.
explanation.definitionFit: A stag night is a bachelor party before a wedding, notorious for heavy drinking.

clue.text: All agree bursar regularly ignored means of calculating

indicators.note: every other letter is skipped at regular intervals, keeping the rest

explanation.surface: Everyone agrees the college treasurer is routinely disregarded.
explanation.definitionFit: Algebra is the branch of mathematics that computes with symbols standing for numbers.

clue.text: Group with common interests in online post?

parts.note: the Net is the internet, so online suggests net
a post is a job, i.e. work

explanation.surface: A social group set up through an online posting.
explanation.definitionFit: A network is a set of people who interact or share contacts or interests.

clue.text: Restrained, therefore drink half-heartedly

parts.note: so means therefore

indicators.note: half the heart, one of the two central letters, is lost

parts.note: beer is a drink

explanation.surface: Remaining restrained, and so drinking without enthusiasm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'half-heartedly' removes one of the two Es in the middle of BEER.
explanation.definitionFit: Sober means sedate and self-controlled, as well as not drunk.

clue.text: Big tree in the main including endless ring

indicators.note: including means the first piece holds the other inside it

parts.note: the main is a literary name for the sea

indicators.note: endless means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a quoit is a ring thrown in a game

explanation.surface: A huge tree out at sea with a ring around it.
explanation.definitionFit: The sequoia, or giant redwood, is among the largest trees on Earth.

clue.text: Trouble after noble fails to end swagger

indicators.note: after places the trouble piece behind the other
failing to end means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: brave can mean noble, valiant
ado is fuss or trouble

explanation.surface: Trouble follows when an aristocrat's swagger falls short.
explanation.definitionFit: Bravado is boastful show of boldness, a swaggering display.

clue.text: Arsonist is more worthless

definitions.meaning: ... as comparative of light, meaning trivial or of little weight

explanation.surface: A fire-raiser branded even more good-for-nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: A lighter is one who ignites; lighter also means less weighty or significant.

clue.text: Create puzzle again when one prepared earlier lacks power

indicators.note: lacks means the following letter is missing from the word

parts.note: a preset is a setting prepared in advance
P is the physics symbol for power

explanation.surface: A setter makes a crossword again because a ready-made one has lost its zip.
explanation.definitionFit: Crossword compilers set puzzles, so to reset is to set again.

clue.text: Spicy quip edited by soldier

indicators.note: edited means the letters are reworked into a new form

parts.note: a soldier ant is a type of worker ant, so ant stands for soldier

explanation.surface: A soldier toning up a racy witticism.
explanation.definitionFit: Piquant means pleasantly sharp or spicy in taste.

clue.text: Questionable debts after American friend goes west

indicators.note: after places the debts behind the friend
in an across answer, going west means reading right to left

parts.note: bud is American slang for a friend
IOUs are written acknowledgements of debt

explanation.surface: Dodgy debts left behind when an American buddy dies.
explanation.walkthrough: 'goes west' is slang for dies, which suits the debts story, but in an across answer it means read backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Dubious means doubtful or suspect, open to question.

clue.text: Theatre accepts indication of alternative reservation

indicators.note: accepts means the first word takes the other inside it

parts.note: the stage means the theatre
or is the word that signals an alternative

explanation.surface: A theatre taking a backup booking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reservation' looks like a ticket booking; it means keeping things in reserve.
explanation.definitionFit: Storage is keeping things in reserve, holding them back for later.

clue.text: Cover pan with a lid, almost producing snack

parts.note: a jacket is a cover, as on a book
a pot is a cooking pan

indicators.note: almost means the word stops one letter short

parts.note: a top is a lid

explanation.surface: Kitchen instructions: put a lid on the pan to make a snack.
explanation.definitionFit: A jacket potato, a baked potato in its skin, is a common British light meal.
